limits: Forced target IDs test timing and pipeline behavior, not free-generation quality or model accuracy.
One ordered B/A/B triplet per case and threshold; no confidence intervals or global-optimum claim.
SSD restore resets model/session state, not expert/PLE caches or elastic capacity. Timing remains subject to those observed confounders.
Decode timing categories overlap. PLE blocked/submit/staging and pipeline stages are not additive; no adjusted/normalized TPS is reported.
The .8 effect is small and overlaps capacity drift; evidence does not justify promoting it. No adaptive-policy result is claimed.
Warmup and 15-token smoke measurements are functional diagnostics only. Desktop telemetry spans the whole run; no decode-only attribution.
